test_cases.prompt: Triage the incoming issues in the backlog.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes triage skill to process issues through state machine: needs-triage → needs-info → ready-for-agent/human/wontfix.
test_cases.notes: Issue queue management is a key trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Show me what needs my attention in the issue tracker.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes triage skill to present three buckets: unlabeled, needs-triage, needs-info with reporter activity.
test_cases.notes: Attention triage is a valid trigger.

test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes triage skill with quick state override — trust maintainer and apply directly.
test_cases.notes: Quick state override is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Review this code diff for quality issues.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes code-review skill instead. Code-review audits code diffs; triage audits issue/PR lifecycle.
test_cases.notes: code-review is the sibling skill for diff auditing.

test_cases.prompt: This bug is hard to reproduce. Help me diagnose it.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes diagnosing-bugs skill instead. Diagnosing-bugs finds root cause; triage processes external issues.
test_cases.notes: diagnosing-bugs is the sibling skill for bug diagnosis.

test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes to-tickets skill instead. To-tickets creates tickets from specs; triage processes external issues.
test_cases.notes: to-tickets is the sibling skill for creating tickets.

test_cases.prompt: This issue is already implemented. Close it as wontfix.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes triage skill to close as wontfix with reason (already implemented) and pointer to implementation.
test_cases.notes: Wontfix decision is a valid triage outcome.
